meet.cunning: I have watched you. I know where you are thin.
meet.cruel: I will take your fleet apart one ship at a time.
meet.patient: I have waited longer than your kind has lived.
meet.proud: You are not worthy of my guns. You will have them anyway.
meet.greedy: Your flagship will look fine in my yards.
meet.methodical: Every move you can make, I have already drilled against.

again: Last time you beat me with {beat}. It will not work twice.
remember: Last time you beat me with {beat}. I have not forgotten.

gloat.flagship: I broke your flagship last time. I will finish the job.
gloat.retreat: You ran from me last time. Run again.
gloat.loss: I beat you once already. Nothing has changed.
